text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek, I have heard from others that
today is
your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I may be so bold as to ask, what sort
of thing
are you interested in? I would
like to present a
proper gift, as thanks
for everything you've done.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Yaeno! You don't need to be so
formal with
me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but thank you. It's more than
enough to
know that you care.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No! Feelings alone cannot possibly
suffice.
Please, at least choose from one
of these.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If by land, a bear. If by water, a shark... I
would
offer something of great strength,
though it's a
mere fraction of what I owe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my... You're so strong, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I think bears and sharks would be
awfully
startled if they saw you coming.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... how about this? Let's make bear
and shark
candies to put on top of a
cake. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you how to make them, so you
can make
my present all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must craft candies... U-understood. If
that is
your wish, I shall do it—no matter
the hardship!
